repairs.quote: Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing (80/115/150/185/220 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage over 4 seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions. If the victim dies, Malzahar gains (2% Mana) Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy. Malefic Visions executes minions below (10 ~ 30) Health.
